plugins.name: haikei
plugins.description: Build and operate AI assistants with the Kei platform: ABAC API org management, kei CLI platform administration, kei-proxy runtime for agent tool calls, runtime setup, credential rotation, harness setup for Claude Code/Codex/OpenCode/Pi/Cursor, agentware SDK policy/audit middleware, Kei runtime setup diagnosis, and DVL Assistant development (ingress security, Teams integration, tool adapters, headless evals, OpenAI backends), and resource-oriented API endpoint conventions (AIP-style routes, custom methods, migrations).
